title: He Walked Into a Bar and Never Walked Out
sources: Wikipedia, 'Disappearance of Brian Shaffer': Brian Randall Shaffer, 27, an Ohio State University College of Medicine student, disappeared in Columbus, Ohio, early on April 1, 2006; security cameras recorded him riding the escalator up to the Ugly Tuna Saloona in the South Campus Gateway at 1:15 AM; he was last seen outside the bar at about 1:55 AM talking with two women; cameras never recorded him leaving; he was due to start a spring break trip to Miami with his girlfriend and missed the Monday flight; he has never been found
